shortDesc: Durable real-time chat built with TypeScript and Cloudflare Durable Objects.
fullDesc:
A template for highly scalable, real-time web applications deployed directly on Cloudflare's edge network.

Core Idea:
Instead of routing websocket connections to a centralised database or application server, this template utilizes Cloudflare Durable Objects to store session and message state directly inside active coordinate workers. This guarantees strong consistency and microsecond-level latency by co-locating room coordination logic and connection handling within the same active compute instance near users.
highlights: State persistence via Cloudflare Durable Objects
Completely serverless edge deployment with zero database configuration
Modern, responsive responsive UI styled with custom CSS variables
